sentence: This project builds a mathematical framework that plans trajectories for groups of uncrewed aerial vehicles while following practical operational constraints.
This project builds a system that uses sensors and virtual reality to study and improve how adolescents ride bicycles and electric scooters safely.
This project studies how brief periods of higher temperature early in development change brain function and behavior in larval zebrafish.
This project builds artificial intelligence systems that turn common terms into vector representations so what they learned can be reused in other applications.
This project builds two methods to measure and map sugar-like molecules called glycosaminoglycans in the sclera, the tough outer wall of the eye.
This project tries to find out how a molecule that plants use to make the hormone ethylene can also trigger responses on its own.
This project builds a tool that uses machine learning and street images to find affordable housing units that suit low-cost passive retrofits.
This project uses artificial intelligence and experiments to design catalysts that help chemical reactions run in plasma.
This project compares filtering seawater with optical instruments to measure particles, then maps particles across the global ocean using machine learning.
This project uses WiFi signals to detect hidden objects inside bags and to identify their shape and material.
This project develops tools that protect wireless networks from attacks by future quantum computers and from attacks on artificial intelligence used to run the networks.
This project builds a curriculum and a hands-on workbench that teach how artificial intelligence is used to attack and defend against malware.
This project runs workshops that teach researchers to use artificial intelligence models and computational tools in their own work.
This project designs a method inspired by how ant colonies spot intruders to help a swarm find faulted agents.
